At Niktara

Niktara is a premium sacred wellness brand founded by Nikki Narulaa, actor and healing expert, born from a devotion to the Das Mahavidya and the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda.

Every product, from fragrance remedies to pain oils, is crafted around the traditional aromatic and energetic associations of the planets and their divine feminine forms, and energised through sacred mantra and Dash Mahavidya Havan.

Curated by certified aromatherapists. Made with pure flower oils, free from synthetic agents and completely alcohol free.
